$comment: Plugins whose hooks run in every session. install.ps1 applies `disable`; verify_live.py section C6 fails on any enabled plugin with a SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit or Stop hook that is in neither map.

disable.simple-english@simple-english: SessionStart injects ~700 tokens of reply rules, PostToolUse lints every .md edit, Stop nags 'five sentences or fewer' after replies; all three fight the orchestrator's report rules. The skill ships in core/skills/simple-english as slash-only.

allow.ponytail@ponytail: integrated: PONYTAIL_SUBAGENT_MATCHER scopes its SubagentStart hook to builder|debugger
allow.remember@claude-plugins-official: memory hooks only, no reply-style rules
allow.watch@claude-video: SessionStart prints a one-line setup notice
allow.last30days@last30days-skill: SessionStart prints a one-line source notice
